meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
India mein **₹3000 ke andar** running shoes ke liye kayi saare acche options available hain, jo beginner runners aur daily joggers ke liye perfect hain. Is price range mein aapko **Campus, Sparx, Red Tape, aur Columbus** jaise brands ke reliable running shoes mil jayenge jo acchi cushioning aur grip dete hain.

Yahan kuch best options ki list di gayi hai:

---

### Top Running Shoes Under ₹3000 in India

| Brand & Model | Key Features | Approximate Price | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Campus OGs / Running Series** | Lightweight, breathable mesh upper, good shock absorption. | ₹1,200 – ₹1,800 | Daily Jogging & Walking |
| **Sparx Running Shoes (SX Series)** | Durable outsole, tough grip, good arch support for daily wear. | ₹1,000 – ₹1,600 | Rough & Tough Usage |
| **Red Tape Sports Shoes** | Stylish design, memory foam/cushioned insoles, flexible sole. | ₹1,500 – ₹2,500 (on sale) | Gym & Casual Running |
| **Columbus Active Running Shoes** | Lightweight, anti-skid sole, breathable fabric. | ₹900 – ₹1,500 | Budget-friendly Beginners |

---

### 💡 Kuch zaroori baatein kharidne se pehle:

* **Breathability:** Aise shoes chunein jinki upper body mesh fabric ki ho, taaki daudte waqt pairon mein pasina kam aaye.
* **Cushioning:** Agar aap road ya pavement par daudte hain, toh thoda soft sole (cushioned sole) wala shoe lein taaki ghutno (knees) par impact kam pade.
* **Size Tip:** Running shoes hamesha apne regular shoe size se **ek size bada (half size up)** lein, kyunki daudte waqt pair thode phoolte hain aur aage ki taraf pressure padta hai.

Aapko inme se kis brand ya specific color/style ka shoe sabse zyada pasand hai?
